## How this army plays

Tough robots that get back up.

## Army rules

Your units have **Reanimation Protocols**.

## Key units

- [[Necron Warriors]] - Cheap, tough Troops that *hold* objectives.
- [[Overlord]] - Your Warlord.
- [[Immortals]] - Elite Troops.
